headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save. In other action, the Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, led by JJ Wetherholt's strong performance. The Kansas City Royals fell short in Minnesota, with Kody Clemens hitting a grand slam in a 3-4 loss to the Twins.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Gavin Hollowell, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago Cubs due to right shoulder inflammation. The Minnesota Twins have also made several roster moves, including transferring Cole Sands to the 60-day injured list and placing Byron Buxton on the 10-day injured list with a right hip impingement.

The Minnesota Twins made a significant trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for shortstop Bruin Agbayani and third baseman Billy Amick. The Los Angeles Angels also made a trade, sending catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-handed pitcher Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers in exchange for shortstop Angel Arredondo.
